# staticform_subscription (Data Source)

The account's billing state and active subscription (read-only). Requires the `User.Billing.Get` permission. The subscription attributes are null when `active` is false.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "staticform_subscription" "current" {}

output "plan_status" {
  value = data.staticform_subscription.current.active ? data.staticform_subscription.current.status : "none"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether an active subscription exists.
- `cancel_at_period_end` (Boolean) Whether the subscription ends at the end of the current period.
- `canceled_at` (String) When the subscription was canceled (RFC 3339). Null when it was not.
- `current_period_end` (String) End of the current billing period (RFC 3339).
- `current_period_start` (String) Start of the current billing period (RFC 3339).
- `entitlements` (List of String) Entitlement keys granted to the account.
- `has_billing_account` (Boolean) Whether the account has a Stripe customer.
- `interval` (String) Billing interval: `Day`, `Week`, `Month`, or `Year`.
- `status` (String) `Incomplete`, `IncompleteExpired`, `Trialing`, `Active`, `PastDue`, `Canceled`, `Unpaid`, or `Paused`.
- `stripe_customer_id` (String) Stripe customer ID.
- `stripe_price_id` (String) Stripe price ID of the subscribed plan.
- `stripe_product_id` (String) Stripe product ID of the subscribed plan.
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription ID.
- `trial_end` (String) End of the trial (RFC 3339). Null when there is no trial.
- `unit_price_amount` (Number) Price per interval in the major unit of `unit_price_currency`.
- `unit_price_currency` (String) Currency of `unit_price_amount`.
